title: Python SDK: Response schema migration & stream assembly helpers
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Add migration utilities and runtime helpers to the Python SDK to enable safe transition from untyped streaming responses to typed pydantic/dataclass models. Deliver a documented set of helper functions for: a) streaming chunk assembly with backpressure-friendly parsing, b) schema-version-aware deserializers, c) idempotent retry wrappers that preserve partially-consumed streams, and d) examples showing pydantic v1/v2 and stdlib dataclass interop.
acceptance_criteria: Library exposes assemble_stream_chunks(stream_iterable) helper with clear memory bounds and tests
Expose parse_with_schema(payload, schema_version) supporting at least two schema versions
Provide retry_preserve_stream(retry_fn) wrapper that preserves idempotency and ensures resume-on-retry semantics for chunked streams
Examples in examples/typed_streams/ demonstrating pydantic model and dataclass hydration for streaming and non-streaming endpoints
Unit + integration tests cover schema migration paths and simulate partial failures to validate retry semantics
API docs and migration guide published to docs.redwood.ai and linked in repository
steps: Design helper APIs and public signatures (Spike)
Add compatibility adapters for pydantic v1/v2 and for dataclasses
Implement retry wrapper and test harness that injects transient errors
Write end-to-end example applications and notebooks
Docs + migration guide + publish release notes
Cut release sdk-python-2.6.0 with migration docs
notes_or_decisions: We will prefer minimal runtime dependencies; avoid forcing pydantic v2 for users who remain on v1.
Use a schema-version header on streaming responses (x-rwinference-schema-version) and include graceful fallback to best-effort parsing.
For dataclasses, use the fast-validate adapter that wraps dataclasses with a thin pydantic model when available.
Retry wrapper will be opt-in and require handler to be pure/side-effect-free or provide checkpoint callback.
testing_plan: Unit tests for helpers; integration tests that spin up a local mock server to emit chunked responses with different schema versions and inject transient connection failures; CI matrix includes pydantic v1 and v2 environments.
